title: Character
description: A character entity in the continuity bible. Tracks identity, current arc phase, psychological wound/belief states, and relationship states with other characters. Arc and belief states are updated by the Character Arc Ledger after each finalized scene.

name.description: Primary name (or pen-name alias used in manuscript).

aliases.description: Other names or nicknames this character may be referred to by.

arc_phase.description: Current position in the character arc. Updated by Character Arc Ledger after each scene.

wound_state.description: Short description of the character's current psychological wound. Evolves across arc phases. Stub — formalize wound taxonomy during Phase 7 implementation.

belief_state.description: Current vs. true core beliefs (the gap drives internal conflict).

current.description: What the character currently believes about themselves/the world (may be false).

true.description: The belief the character needs to reach by arc resolution.

relationship_states.description: Map of other_character_id → relationship status. Updated by Character Arc Ledger. Stub — formalize relationship taxonomy during Phase 7 implementation.

status.description: Current relationship status (e.g. strangers, hostile, tense, allies, romantic_tension, committed).

last_updated_scene.description: Scene ID of the most recent state change.

physical.description: Physical description anchors for continuity. Stub — expand during Phase 4 implementation.

voice.description: Dialogue voice fingerprint for this character (feeds per_character_voice_check). Stub — expand during Phase 6 implementation.

taboos.description: Character-level hard constraints (things this character would never do). Violation → RE-PLAN.
